mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for purchasing a property intended for Airbnb rental with a real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process involves an initial consultation to understand your investment goals, budget, and target areas within Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County. Next, we identify suitable properties that align with short-term rental potential and local regulations. After selection, we assist with making an offer, negotiating, and navigating the closing process. Our team at Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can streamline this by connecting you with local experts for financing, property management, and legal counsel specific to Airbnb investments, ensuring a smoother transaction from search to closing.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, property identification, offer, negotiation, and closing, with assistance from a real estate agent and local experts for Airbnb-specific needs.
